aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Lured by a hypnotic melody to an isolated island, a young woman steps back into reality only to find twenty-five years have instantly passed, leaving her unaged amidst a fractured family.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After following a haunting melody onto a remote tidal island, Lily crosses back at low tide expecting only moments to have passed, but instead steps into a future a quarter-century later. Unaged and disoriented, she must navigate a world where her loved ones have grown old, her grief-stricken family has splintered, and her infant son is now a troubled adult. As unsettling apparitions and supernatural phenomena begin to stalk her, Lily realizes she did not return from the island alone. She and her son must uncover the centuries-old supernatural secret keeping souls trapped out of time before the island claims them both.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Having mysteriously vanished for days as a young girl, adult Lily remains perpetually captivated by an ethereal melody that only she can hear. Driven by this obsession, she follows the tune onto a secluded tidal island off the coast, stepping into a localized pocket of supernatural stillness. When she returns during the next low tide believing mere minutes have elapsed, she is horrified to discover that twenty-five years have actually passed. While Lily remains completely unaged, the world around her has moved on, leaving her aging father, devastated sister, and now-adult son to grapple with her miraculous reappearance. Her grown son Jared, who bears deep emotional trauma from growing up without a mother, shares her sensitivity to the mysterious sound. As Lily struggles to adjust to her lost decades and rebuild broken family bonds, threatening visions of long-deceased strangers begin haunting her everyday reality. Realizing the island harbors a timeless, dark entity that collects missing souls, Lily and Jared race to decipher historical mysteries spanning centuries. Ultimately, Lily must confront the dark forces bound to the island to free her family from a lingering nightmare.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Based on J.M. Barrie's haunting stage play 'Mary Rose', 'The Island Between Tides' centers on Lily, a young mother who vanishes after following an irresistible melody onto a coastal tidal island. Believing she was gone for only a fleeting moment, Lily returns across the low tide into a devastating reality: twenty-five years have elapsed in the outside world. While her father, sister, and infant son have grown older and suffered decades of grief, Lily has not aged a single day. As she tries to comprehend the time loss and reconnect with her now-grown son, unsettling sightings of long-dead figures suggest that something malevolent crossed back over the water with her. To protect her family and make sense of her lost life, Lily must delve into the island's mysterious history before its ghostly pull drags her back permanently.

story_structure.resolution: Coralie finds closure with her altered life and remaining family, learning to bridge the gap between her lost past and an uncertain future while honoring the island's timeless mystery.
story_structure.introduction: Coralie, a young woman living on a remote Scottish island, follows a haunting, mysterious melody across the tidal flats to an isolated island, completely unaware of its ancient folklore.
story_structure.risingAction: As Coralie struggles to navigate a modern world where she is legally dead and her loved ones have aged or passed away, she uncovers dark family secrets and delves into local mythology to understand the nature of the island's temporal trap.
